data.one_liner: Automatically convert relative and absolute import paths in Dart files.
data.what_it_does: It scans your lib, bin, test, and tests folders to automatically convert relative imports to absolute package imports (or vice versa). You can run it via the command line or configure it in your pubspec.yaml file.
use_when: You want a consistent import path style across your Dart and Flutter codebase.
You want to enforce import formatting rules in a CI pipeline using --exit-if-changed.
avoid_when: You prefer manual control over every import path without automated formatting.
Your project relies on tooling that conflicts with automated path conversion.
strengths: Supports command-line execution and CI integration with flags like --exit-if-changed.
Configurable through pubspec.yaml to ignore specific files or toggle relative paths.
weaknesses: Limited documentation regarding advanced custom configurations beyond the provided examples.
Relies on external regex or command-line filtering for granular control.
data.setup_notes: Add the package as a dev dependency using `flutter pub add --dev import_path_converter` and run via `flutter pub run import_path_converter:main`.
